It is easy to post a one-sided version online. It is harder to acknowledge one’s own actions.

At Zenia’s, we stand by our service, our staff and our standards.
Team Zenia’s Salon, Mumbai

While bleach-free colouring can sometimes result in subtler highlights, we strive to achieve the closest possible match based on our clients’ preferences.

To ensure transparency, we always provide an estimated duration and cost of the service before beginning. Typically, hair colouring services can take around 3-4 hours, as they involve a detailed consultation, colour selection, and precise application techniques to deliver the best possible results.

We regret seeing your review late due to a recent Google password issue that temporarily affected our account access. If you were unhappy with the colour after two weeks, we would have appreciated a call at that time, as we would have been more than happy to address your concerns directly.

Thank you once again for your valuable feedback, and we hope to have the opportunity to serve you better in the future.

Warm regards,
The Cut Collective Team
